episodes.title: Moment of Truth
episodes.summary: Luke tries to keep a low profile and pay his bills by working two jobs. However, he gets into trouble anyway when he has a one-nighter with a police detective, who is investigating an arms deal that local crime lord Cornell "Cottonmouth" Stokes was engineering.

episodes.title: Code of the Streets
episodes.summary: Pop asks Luke for help finding Chico so that he can set up a parlay with Cornell to get his money back. However, Cornell's lieutenant Tone has other plans.

episodes.title: Who's Gonna Take the Weight?
episodes.summary: After Pop's death, Luke sets out to take Cornell down by taking his money. However, both Cornell and Misty figure out that Luke is responsible.

episodes.title: Step in the Arena
episodes.summary: As Luke fights for his life beneath a toppled building, he remembers his past and the experimental treatment at Seagate Prison that gave him his powers.

episodes.title: Just to Get a Rep
episodes.summary: Cornell takes the battle to Luke when he tells his men to squeeze the people of Harlem for everything they have... and blame Luke. Meanwhile, Misty receives word that her partner Scarfe may be crooked.

episodes.title: Suckas Need Bodyguards
episodes.summary: When Scarfe tries to hold up Cornell for more money, Cornell shoots him. Badly wounded, Scarfe turns to Luke for help and offers to give him the evidence that will put Cornell away for good.

episodes.title: Manifest
episodes.summary: While Mariah faces pressure to resign, Cornell tries to blackmail Luke into working for him. In the past, Cornell and Mariah's history with Mama Mabel is revealed.

episodes.title: Blowin' Up the Spot
episodes.summary: After Cornell's death, Mariah covers up her involvement with Shades' help and sets up Luke as the patsy. Meanwhile, Luke finds out Diamondback's true identity.

episodes.title: DWYCK
episodes.summary: Stryker tightens his grip on Cornell's criminal empire, while Mariah plots to take advantage of Luke's attack on two cops to turn the public against him.

episodes.title: Take It Personal
episodes.summary: After Claire and Burstein save his life, Luke learns some of what Reva was hiding from him. Meanwhile, Mariah tries to turn the people of Harlem against Luke as part of Stryker's scheme to sell his super-weapons.

episodes.title: Now You're Mine
episodes.summary: When Luke busts into his club, Stryker turns the situation around and makes Luke look like the guilty party. Meanwhile, Misty's life is in danger and Claire is the only one who can help her.

episodes.title: Soliloquy of Chaos
episodes.summary: After the events at the club, Stryker is forced to go on the run and orders Zip to eliminate Shades. Meanwhile, Luke gets a lead on Stryker's location and Mariah offers him what he needs to clear his name.

episodes.title: You Know My Steez
episodes.summary: After a fierce battle with Stryker, Luke is taken into custody while Misty tries to arrest Mariah for the murder of her cousin Cornell.

episodes.title: Soul Brother #1
episodes.summary: Luke takes on heroin dealers branding their product with his name, and finds himself becoming increasingly famous. Meanwhile, Misty returns to work after losing her arm, and a new player enters Harlem.

episodes.title: Straighten It Out
episodes.summary: Mariah tries to rebuild her reputation by rebuilding her relationship with her daughter; Luke and Shades lose their tempers; Claire worries about Luke.

episodes.title: Wig Out
episodes.summary: Luke lashes out at Misty and Claire. Misty turns to a friend to deal with her anger, while Claire pays a visit to father James.

episodes.title: I Get Physical
episodes.summary: Luke teams up with Misty to check on the Yardies, but discovers that they have moved on. Meanwhile, Bushmaster confronts Mariah, Misty gets an invitation from Danny and Colleen, and Bobby gets a call from his daughter.

episodes.title: All Souled Out
episodes.summary: While Mariah tells Tilda the truth about the family business, Luke entertains at a party and Misty considers the case against Cockroach.

episodes.title: The Basement
episodes.summary: Luke takes refuges with Piranha to keep Bushmaster from acquiring the money man. Meanwhile, Shades and Comanche discuss old times, and Misty contemplates her future with the department.

episodes.title: On and On
episodes.summary: Misty hands in her resignation, while Shades discovers who the snitch is in Mariah's organization.

episodes.title: If It Ain't Rough, It Ain't Right
episodes.summary: In the aftermath of the brownstone fire, Bushmaster puts a price on Mariah's head... and the heads of anyone connected to Luke.

episodes.title: For Pete's Sake
episodes.summary: Luke and Misty take their group into hiding at a Rand facility under construction. While they try to negotiate an immunity deal for Mariah, Bushmaster learns where they are thanks to his snitch in the department.

episodes.title: The Main Ingredient
episodes.summary: Danny--the Immortal Iron Fist--pays Luke a visit and offers to help him find Bushmaster. Meanwhile, Mariah regains her stolen forms and Misty confronts the traitor in the precinct house.

episodes.title: The Creator
episodes.summary: Luke finds the only survivor of the restaurant massacre and tries to persuade her to testify against Mariah. Meanwhile, Bushmaster remembers his childhood while fighting for his life with Tilda's help.

episodes.title: Can't Front on Me
episodes.summary: After arranging a drug distribution deal with the Chinese, Mariah distributes "Bushmaster heroin" throughout Harlem in an attempt do draw her rival out. She also throws a charity jam, well aware that Luke will come to protect the innocents when Bushmaster attacks her.

episodes.title: They Reminisce Over You
episodes.summary: Hell breaks in loose in Harlem after Mariah goes to prison, and Luke attempts to broker a peace with the warring crime families.
